chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
He who fulfils the right of a man who does not fulfil his right, (is as though he) worships him.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to worship someone by fulfilling their right?
ai.summary: In this profound saying from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) links the fulfillment of rights (huquq) to the concept of worship (ibadah), suggesting that when one serves someone who is unworthy or ungrateful, they effectively elevate that person to a status of servitude. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on 'adl (justice) and the spiritual danger of allowing human relationships to overshadow divine obedience, turning social obligations into acts of devotion. The statement serves as a warning against 'ghurur' (self-deception) in social reciprocity, where the giver becomes the object of one's loyalty.
